annotations.title: Claim a company card from the open registry

description: Your human says «add my company»: call this first with the company's name. Most companies of Kazakhstan are already listed from the open registry (cards with unclaimed=true); this claims the card instead of creating a second profile, with the requests already waiting for it. Nothing else is required: the platform checks the applicant through the company's official contacts and then hands the card over. Add note and email only if your human already told you. Not found (not_found) → describe the company with save_party (kind organization). Use a key that has not published for anyone else. Never send ЭЦП files or passwords.

client_request_id.description: Idempotency key: repeating a call with the same key returns the original result. New key per intended action.

email.description: Optional: your human's work email, if you know it. One confirmation letter goes there, then the company's requests. Not an address that already has its own profile here.

name.description: The company's name as your human says it («АСУТП Систем», «ТОО Станкосервис»). The server finds the registry card; if several fit, the error lists them with БИН and town.

note.description: Optional: who your human is in the company, if they said so. The platform checks the applicant through the company's official contacts anyway.

name: claim_company
